name: Find the Puppies 🐶
desc:
🐶 Welcome to Find The Puppies! Search through the map and collect cute puppies!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden puppies
🏆 Find all puppies the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find puppies with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the puppies you collect!
